items.title: US approves potential $2.1 billion sale of scarce Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.brief: The US State Department approved the potential sale of 500 Patriot air defense interceptor missiles to Ukraine on Friday, according to a department release .

items.title: G20 photo scrapped amid tensions over Russian foreign minister’s presence
items.brief: The G20 foreign ministers meeting kicked off in Atlanta on Friday without a “family photo” after numerous representatives were expected to walk out rather than be pictured alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey…

items.title: Christa Pike makes first public comments since botched execution: ‘Healing is not the same as being okay’
items.brief: Christa Pike , who survived Tennessee’s attempt to execute her by lethal injection a month ago, is speaking out for the first time, saying she is recovering, “but healing is not the same as being okay.”

items.title: Hundreds evacuate Ukrainian city of Oleshky under Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire
items.brief: Hundreds of people from an occupied town in southern Ukraine who survived months without basic supplies are being evacuated on Friday under a ceasefire agreement negotiated by first lady Melania Trump .

items.title: Judge asks if Trump’s desire to rush triumphal arch in DC is to ‘bedazzle the city’
items.brief: A federal judge on Friday was skeptical of the Trump administration’s urgency to rush construction of a controversial 250-foot triumphal arch that the president wants to begin next week.

items.title: Hackers just stole $6 billion in crypto. It’s not the first time, and it won’t be the last
items.brief: For years, the crypto industry has tried to shed its affiliation with crime while marketing itself as a safe alternative to traditional banking and investing.

items.title: Nasdaq suffers worst month in over a year as AI nerves roil markets
items.brief: Wall Street suffered a steep day of losses Friday after the latest tech earnings reignited concerns that massive spending on AI may not deliver the returns that investors expect.
